title: INSPECTORRAGET: An Introspection Platform for RAG Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-as-a-judge (e.g., GPT-4) evaluations with human expert annotations to detect if the LLM disproportionately favors responses generated by its own underlying model.
Correlating the length of model responses with evaluation win-rates to determine if longer answers are disproportionately preferred by human annotators or LLM judges regardless of actual quality.
Analyzing head-to-head model comparison data to investigate if the order in which responses are presented (e.g., being shown first) artificially inflates an evaluator's preference for that response.
